arguments.sql: SELECT SUM(t.amount_usd_cents) / 100.0 AS total_spent_usd FROM transactions t JOIN cards c ON t.card_id = c.id WHERE c.credit_limit_usd_cents > 2000000
arguments.explanation: Totals the amount of all transactions made on cards whose credit limit is above $20,000, converted from cents to dollars.
assumptions: Credit limit is stored in cents, so $20,000 is 2000000 and 'above' means strictly greater than that.
All transactions on those cards are included, whether or not they carry a fraud label.
Negative amounts (56,900 rows, meaning undocumented) are included as recorded, not removed or treated as refunds.
Covers the full data range, 2019-01-01 to 2019-10-31.
